shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the open door of a bright university lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室！这一课讲安全入门。

shots.scene: 规则本、护目镜、通风柜、出口标志四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank rule book, safety goggles, a fume hood and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 规则、防护、设备、应急，一样都不能少。

shots.scene: 阿杰背着书包走进实验室，兴奋地四处张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into the lab carrying a backpack and looks around excitedly.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，干劲十足。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着短袖、凉鞋，伸手就去拿试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a T-shirt and sandals reaches for a reagent bottle with a blank label on the bench.
shots.narration: 没换衣服，他就想马上开始做实验。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着门边的空白告示和防护柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a blank notice on the door and a cabinet of protective gear.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先别动，先认识实验室。

shots.scene: 老周走过来，递给阿杰一本空白安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks over and hands the young male student a blank lab safety handbook.
shots.narration: 老周说：今天第一课，先学安全。

shots.scene: 小研同时盯着几台仪器，手里拿满东西
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student juggles a notebook and sample tubes while watching several instruments at once.
shots.narration: 实验室里事情多，常常忙得团团转。

shots.scene: 一个人手里拿满东西，头顶的安全图标慢慢变淡
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with full hands; a shield icon above its head slowly fades away. No people.
shots.narration: 一忙起来，最容易忘的就是安全。

shots.scene: 实验室房间图标上方出现黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab room icon with a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 稍不留神，实验室就会变得很危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己摇摇头，旁边是学位帽图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at itself and shakes its head beside a graduation cap icon.
shots.narration: 学历再高、资历再老，人都会犯错。

shots.scene: 一条弯曲的正路和一条抄近路的小道，小道被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A long safe path with check marks and a shortcut path cutting across, the shortcut crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 越忙越想抄近路，跳过防护步骤。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指提醒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger with a serious look.
shots.narration: 越忙，越要按规矩来。

shots.section_title: 进新实验室，先学安全规则
shots.scene: 阿杰找到墙上的电灯开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds the light switch on the lab wall next to the door.
shots.narration: 熟悉灯开关在哪的时候，
overlay: 进新实验室，先学安全规则

shots.section_title: 进新实验室，先学安全规则
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰看门边的灭火器和出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows the young male student a fire extinguisher and an emergency exit sign by the door.
shots.narration: 也要同时学会这里的安全规则。

shots.scene: 小研翻开一本空白的安全技术说明书文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a thick binder of blank safety data sheets next to reagent bottles.
shots.narration: 先认识安全技术说明书，简称SDS。

shots.scene: 说明书页面上三个图标：成分、性质、危害
shots.prompt_en: A blank data sheet page with three icons: a molecule, a thermometer and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 它写明物质的成分、性质和危害。

shots.section_title: 安全管理制度与安全手册
shots.scene: 老周把空白安全手册和管理制度放在桌上
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a blank lab safety handbook and a blank rules binder on a desk.
shots.narration: 学校和实验室有安全管理制度和手册。
overlay: 安全管理制度与安全手册

shots.section_title: 安全管理制度与安全手册
shots.scene: 手册里有化学品、生物、电气、消防等图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank handbook opened to pages with icons for chemicals, biohazard, electricity and fire. No people.
shots.narration: 怎样安全使用化学品，里面都有写。

shots.section_title: 安全管理制度与安全手册
shots.scene: 生物危害标志放在一本空白手册旁
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign next to a blank biosafety manual. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性材料等各类危害，也有专门规定。

shots.section_title: 专项制度：废物、上锁挂牌、呼吸防护
shots.scene: 废液桶、挂锁加标签牌、呼吸器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a waste container, a padlock with a blank hanging tag, and a respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 还有危险废物、上锁挂牌、呼吸防护。
overlay: 专项制度：废物、上锁挂牌、呼吸防护

shots.section_title: 专项制度：废物、上锁挂牌、呼吸防护
shots.scene: 老李给设备电源开关挂上锁和空白标签牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attaches a padlock and a blank tag to the power switch of a machine under repair.
shots.narration: 检修设备时上锁挂牌，防止被误启动。

shots.section_title: 灭火器、急救与心肺复苏培训
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室演示灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator demonstrates a fire extinguisher to a small group of students in a training room.
shots.narration: 可以参加灭火器使用培训，
overlay: 灭火器、急救与心肺复苏培训

shots.section_title: 灭火器、急救与心肺复苏培训
shots.scene: 学生们在垫子上对模拟人练习心肺复苏
shots.prompt_en: Students practice chest compressions on a CPR training manikin on a mat while the safety administrator watches.
shots.narration: 还有急救和心肺复苏培训。

shots.section_title: 安全的最终责任在自己
shots.scene: 空白课程证书和空白手册图标，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank training certificate and a blank handbook, with a question mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 可课程和手册，只是信息。
overlay: 安全的最终责任在自己

shots.section_title: 安全的最终责任在自己
shots.scene: 阿杰戴好护目镜，认真检查操作步骤
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and carefully checks a blank procedure card on the bench.
shots.narration: 把知识用起来，要靠你自己。

shots.section_title: 安全的最终责任在自己
shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍胸口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats its own chest with a confident nod.
shots.narration: 安全的最终责任，在你自己身上。

shots.scene: 小研在空白计划表上写下步骤
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes steps on a blank planning sheet at her desk.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先把工作计划好。

shots.scene: 试剂、器皿和SDS文件夹整齐摆在台上
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles with blank labels, glassware and a blank data sheet binder neatly laid out on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 提前备齐材料，还有对应的SDS。

shots.section_title: 按化学品和操作选防护
shots.scene: 小研对照SDS，挑选护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks at a blank data sheet and picks goggles and gloves from a shelf.
shots.narration: 防护用品，要按化学品和操作来选。
overlay: 按化学品和操作选防护

shots.section_title: 按化学品和操作选防护
shots.scene: 低温手套和液氮罐图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of thick insulated cryogenic gloves next to a liquid nitrogen dewar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如取液氮，就要戴防冻手套。

shots.section_title: 哪些区域必须穿戴防护
shots.scene: 实验室门上贴着戴护目镜的指令标志
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with a wear eye protection sign and a wear protective clothing sign. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室都规定了必须防护的区域。
overlay: 哪些区域必须穿戴防护

shots.section_title: 哪些区域必须穿戴防护
shots.scene: 阿杰站在门口看标志，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at the lab door, reads the signs and nods.
shots.narration: 进门前看清标志，按要求穿戴。

shots.scene: 小研打开防护用品柜，里面整齐放着护目镜、手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a cabinet neatly stocked with goggles, gloves and lab coats.
shots.narration: 防护用品常常集中存放，要知道在哪。

shots.scene: 老周把一副新护目镜递给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a new pair of safety goggles to the young male student.
shots.narration: 工作需要的防护用品，实验室会配备。

shots.scene: 安全眼镜、护目镜、面屏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: safety glasses with side shields, sealed goggles and a full face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 眼部防护特别重要，种类也很多。

shots.scene: 小研戴上护目镜，再加一层面屏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on sealed goggles and then lowers a face shield over them.
shots.narration: 按工作选合适的一种，或者组合使用。

shots.scene: 普通近视眼镜图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of ordinary prescription glasses crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通近视眼镜，不能代替护目镜。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿上实验服，扣好扣子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a white lab coat and buttons it all the way up.
shots.narration: 实验服也是防护用品。

shots.scene: 液滴溅到实验服上被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Liquid droplets splash toward a lab coat and are stopped by the fabric. No people.
shots.narration: 意外溅洒时，它能替你挡一下。

shots.scene: 几种不同材质的手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Several glove icons of different materials and thicknesses in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 手套也要选对。

shots.scene: 小研对照SDS，从手套盒里取手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank data sheet and takes gloves from a glove box dispenser.
shots.narration: 按材料和设备的危害来选手套。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训与适合性检验
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一只呼吸器去问老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a respirator and asks the older man a question.
shots.narration: 要不要戴呼吸器，先问实验室负责人。
overlay: 呼吸器：培训与适合性检验

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训与适合性检验
shots.scene: 王老师帮小研做呼吸器贴合检查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator helps the female graduate student check the face seal of a half mask respirator.
shots.narration: 需要的话，必须先培训、做适合性检验。

shots.section_title: 呼吸器：培训与适合性检验
shots.scene: 面罩边缘漏气的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a respirator mask with air leaking around its edge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴不严实的呼吸器，起不到保护作用。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与自给式呼吸器
shots.scene: 半面罩呼吸器和滤盒图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a half mask respirator with two filter cartridges, arrows showing air passing through the cartridges. No people.
shots.narration: 最常用的是过滤式呼吸器。
overlay: 过滤式与自给式呼吸器

shots.section_title: 过滤式与自给式呼吸器
shots.scene: 滤盒截住污染物小颗粒
shots.prompt_en: Tiny contaminant particles are trapped inside a filter cartridge while clean air passes through. No people.
shots.narration: 滤盒在吸入前把污染物拦下来。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与自给式呼吸器
shots.scene: 背架气瓶式呼吸器图标，旁边一个警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a self-contained breathing apparatus with a back-mounted air cylinder and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 自给式空气呼吸器，只用于极端情况。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与自给式呼吸器
shots.scene: 没受过培训的人伸手去拿它，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained person reaching for the breathing apparatus, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 结构复杂，没经过培训不要佩戴。

shots.scene: 凉鞋和露趾鞋图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sandals and open-toe shoes crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室，不穿露脚趾的鞋。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上封闭的皮鞋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student changes into closed leather shoes.
shots.narration: 封闭的鞋，能挡住洒落的化学品。

shots.scene: 带护趾的安全鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a safety shoe with a protective toe cap and a thick sole. No people.
shots.narration: 有的实验室还要求穿安全鞋。

shots.scene: 小研把手套对着光检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a glove and checks it carefully for holes.
shots.narration: 防护用品，用前先检查。

shots.scene: 破洞手套和裂纹护目镜图标，旁边是垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a torn glove and cracked goggles next to a trash bin with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 有裂纹、磨损，就修好或丢掉换新。

shots.scene: 阿杰在门口脱下实验服挂好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off his lab coat and hangs it on a hook by the lab door.
shots.narration: 离开实验区前，脱下实验服和防护用品。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽用洗手液洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands with soap at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 再认真洗手。

shots.scene: 穿实验服走进餐厅的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person in a lab coat and gloves walking into a cafeteria, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别把污染带出实验室。

shots.scene: 小研逐件检查仪器和装置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks each piece of apparatus on the bench one by one.
shots.narration: 实验装置和设备，搭之前逐件检查。

shots.scene: 干净的仪器旁打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Clean apparatus and a working instrument with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 要干净，要能正常工作。

shots.scene: 手持烧杯对光检查，杯口有小缺口
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds up a beaker to the light, revealing a small chip on the rim. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃器皿有缺口或裂纹，

shots.scene: 有裂纹的烧瓶被红叉划掉，放进碎玻璃收集箱
shots.prompt_en: A cracked flask crossed out with a red X goes into a broken glass collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 必须换掉，一受力就可能碎裂。

shots.scene: 用饮料瓶装试剂的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink bottle used as a chemical container, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 需要专用设备和容器，就用专用的。

shots.scene: 胶带缠着的临时支架被红叉划掉，专用夹具打勾
shots.prompt_en: A makeshift stand wrapped in tape crossed out with a red X; a proper lab clamp and stand with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 临时凑合的替代品，很危险。

shots.scene: 阿杰把台面上的杂物收拾整齐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clears clutter off the bench and puts things back in order.
shots.narration: 保持实验室整洁，不堆杂物。

shots.scene: 过道上的椅子和纸箱绊人的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person tripping over a chair and boxes left in an aisle. No people.
shots.narration: 乱放的设备和家具，容易绊倒人。

shots.scene: 阿杰把椅子推回桌下，向老周报告地上的积水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pushes a chair back under the bench, then tells the older man about a puddle on the floor.
shots.narration: 发现不安全状况，及时报告、纠正。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a fume hood with its sash half open.
shots.narration: 要会用通风柜等通风设施。

shots.scene: 通风柜剖面，箭头显示气流把蒸气带走
shots.prompt_en: A simple side cutaway of a fume hood; arrows show room air flowing in and carrying vapors up the exhaust. No people.
shots.narration: 正常工作时，气流把蒸气约束并排走。

shots.scene: 柜口一道“空气帘”挡住蒸气外逸
shots.prompt_en: Arrows across the hood opening form an invisible air curtain that keeps vapors inside. No people.
shots.narration: 柜口的空气帘，挡住蒸气外逸。

shots.scene: 小研把视窗拉低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the hood sash down to a low working height.
shots.narration: 但视窗仍要尽量放低。

shots.scene: 柜口堆满大件物品挡住气流，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crammed with large items blocking the airflow, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能干扰通风柜里的气流。

shots.scene: 被挡住的气流打着旋飘向人的呼吸区
shots.prompt_en: Blocked airflow swirls and vapor drifts out toward a person pictogram's face. No people.
shots.narration: 否则效果变差，污染空气会被吸进去。

shots.scene: 化学通风柜和生物安全柜两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a chemical fume hood and a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子种类很多，要按操作选对。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜挡住小雾点，旁边的化学品瓶图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet containing tiny mist droplets, with a chemical bottle icon and a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜防感染性气溶胶，不一定防化学品。

shots.scene: 小研看通风柜的风量显示，并用纸条测试气流
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the airflow indicator on the hood and holds a thin paper strip at the opening; it bends inward.
shots.narration: 使用前先测试，确认柜子工作正常。

shots.scene: 柜内台面上一条距柜口的标线，器皿放在线内
shots.prompt_en: A line marked on the hood work surface some distance in from the front edge; glassware sits behind the line. No people.
shots.narration: 操作要在柜内深处，离柜口至少15厘米。

shots.section_title: 台面和通风柜不是仓库
shots.scene: 台面和通风柜里堆满试剂瓶，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bench top and a fume hood crowded with many reagent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 台面和通风柜，别当成化学品仓库。
overlay: 台面和通风柜不是仓库

shots.section_title: 台面和通风柜不是仓库
shots.scene: 试剂瓶被碰倒，旁边有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle tips over on a bench near a small flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放在这里容易碰倒，着火时也没保护。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体：安全罐与储存柜
shots.scene: 带弹簧盖的红色金属安全罐
shots.prompt_en: A red metal safety can with a spring-loaded lid and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 少量易燃液体，放进合格的安全罐。
overlay: 易燃液体：安全罐与储存柜

shots.section_title: 易燃液体：安全罐与储存柜
shots.scene: 小研把试剂放进黄色易燃品储存柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places reagent bottles into a yellow flammable storage cabinet with a flammable warning sign.
shots.narration: 量多的，放进易燃品储存柜。

shots.section_title: 压缩气瓶：远离火源、固定牢靠
shots.scene: 气瓶远离火焰和火花图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder standing far from flame and spark icons, with a distance arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩气瓶，要远离明火和火花。
overlay: 压缩气瓶：远离火源、固定牢靠

shots.section_title: 压缩气瓶：远离火源、固定牢靠
shots.scene: 老李用链条把气瓶固定在墙上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer secures a gas cylinder to the wall with a chain and a strap.
shots.narration: 用链条或绑带固定，防止倒下。

shots.section_title: 压缩气瓶：远离火源、固定牢靠
shots.scene: 气瓶倒地、软管被扯脱的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a falling cylinder with its hose ripping loose, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶一倒，软管也可能被扯脱。

shots.section_title: 压缩气瓶：远离火源、固定牢靠
shots.scene: 阿杰问老周，墙边几只气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man a question while pointing at a row of cylinders by the wall.
shots.narration: 实验室能放几瓶，按学校规定来。

shots.scene: 阿杰给容器贴上标签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sticks a blank label onto a new container of solution.
shots.narration: 必须清楚自己在用什么。

shots.scene: 一排容器都有标签，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A row of containers all with blank labels and hazard pictograms, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 每个容器都要标清楚，谁看都明白。

shots.scene: 只写了三个字母的烧杯，打一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A beaker with a label showing only a scribble and a big question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 只写缩写，别人可能看不懂。

shots.scene: 同一个缩写指向两个不同的瓶子，一个有警示标志
shots.prompt_en: One short tag with arrows pointing to two different bottles, one bearing a health hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 同一个缩写，可能是致癌物，也可能是溶剂。

shots.scene: 小研在标签上写全称，旁边是SDS文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes the full name on a label next to a blank data sheet binder.
shots.narration: 写全称，别人也方便查到SDS。

shots.scene: 新合成的样品瓶旁，SDS文件夹空着
shots.prompt_en: A small vial of a newly made compound next to an empty data sheet binder slot. No people.
shots.narration: 新合成的物质，可能没有SDS。

shots.scene: 小研和老周查文献、讨论防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man study blank reference books and discuss precautions.
shots.narration: 先弄清性质，做好一切必要防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰偷偷摆弄仪器的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person secretly starting an unapproved experiment alone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 未经批准的实验，绝对不允许。

shots.scene: 无人的实验室里冒烟，门外的人一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: An empty lab with a small puff of smoke near a bench; outside, people look puzzled with question marks. No people inside.
shots.narration: 出了事你不在场，没人知道怎么处理。

shots.scene: 化学废液桶和生物危害废物袋
shots.prompt_en: A closed chemical waste container with a blank label and a biohazard waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 化学和感染性废物，要按制度处理。

shots.scene: 小研在计划表上画出废物去向
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws arrows to waste container icons on her blank planning sheet.
shots.narration: 开工之前，就想好废物怎么处置。

shots.scene: 河流、人群和法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a river, a group of people and a judge's gavel with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 处置出错，会危害健康和环境。

shots.scene: 单位要承担法律责任的图标
shots.prompt_en: A university building icon with a gavel and a document icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 单位还要承担法律责任。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator a question about a waste container.
shots.narration: 拿不准，就问负责人或安全管理人员。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开空白应急预案
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank emergency plan booklet.
shots.narration: 出了事故，必须知道怎么做。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白的应急电话表
shots.prompt_en: A blank emergency phone list posted on the wall next to a lab phone. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉应急程序，记住应急电话。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研沿疏散路线走，经过出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student walk along the evacuation route past emergency exit signs.
shots.narration: 疏散路线，要亲自完整走一遍。

shots.scene: 两人走下楼梯，到达室外集合点
shots.prompt_en: The two walk down the stairwell and arrive at an outdoor assembly point.
shots.narration: 弄清楚途中要经过哪些地方。

shots.scene: 老周指着墙上的手动火灾报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The older man points to a manual fire alarm call point on the corridor wall.
shots.narration: 向负责人了解报警和应急系统。

shots.scene: 手动报警按钮、声光报警器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a manual fire alarm call point and a fire alarm bell with a flashing light. No people.
shots.narration: 报警按钮在哪，警报响了怎么办。

shots.scene: 灭火器、泄漏处理箱的位置图标
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher and a spill kit box mounted on a lab wall with location pins above them. No people.
shots.narration: 知道灭火器、泄漏处理箱在哪。

shots.scene: 没受过培训的人举灭火器冲向大火，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an untrained person charging at a large fire with an extinguisher, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没受过培训，不要硬上。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一颗红心，旁边一堆仪器图标较小
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big red heart; small instrument icons sit off to the side.
shots.narration: 永远记住：生命高于财产。

shots.scene: 台面上化学品洒了一片
shots.prompt_en: A spilled liquid puddle on a lab bench next to a tipped bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 要随时准备应对化学品泄漏。

shots.scene: 电热板和电源开关被关掉，火焰图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate switch turned off and a flame icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃物泄漏，先关掉所有点火源。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和紧急喷淋
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above an eyewash station next to an emergency shower. No people.
shots.narration: 知道洗眼器和喷淋在哪、怎么用。

shots.scene: 小研扶着阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student rinse his eyes at the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 沾到化学品，马上用流动清水冲洗。

shots.scene: 喷淋下冲洗，旁边计时器
shots.prompt_en: Water flows from an emergency shower; a stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗至少15分钟。

shots.scene: 被污染的衣物和隐形眼镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a contaminated shirt being removed and a contact lens being taken out. No people.
shots.narration: 脱去污染衣物，摘掉隐形眼镜。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，阿杰被送去医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call while the young male student is helped toward the door.
shots.narration: 然后报告事故，及时就医。

shots.section_title: 最重要的是学会安全工作
shots.scene: 阿杰在新实验室里认识同事
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shakes hands with new lab mates in the lab.
shots.narration: 新实验室，既兴奋又有压力。
overlay: 最重要的是学会安全工作

shots.section_title: 最重要的是学会安全工作
shots.scene: 新同事、新材料、新流程三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a group of people, a set of reagent bottles and a flowchart with blank boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 新同事、新材料、新流程。

shots.section_title: 最重要的是学会安全工作
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 最重要的，是学会安全地工作。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室上课，学生们记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a safety training class while students take notes in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先参加安全准入培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑上答题，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes an online safety test on a computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 考核合格，才能独立做实验。

shots.scene: 空白准入证书上打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank access certificate with a green check mark and a lab door icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫先培训、后准入。

shots.section_title: 三级管理与负责人责任
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三级链条图标
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons from top to bottom: a university building, a department building and a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实验室实行三级安全管理。
overlay: 三级管理与负责人责任

shots.section_title: 三级管理与负责人责任
shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口的空白责任牌旁
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands next to a blank responsibility plate at the lab door.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人是安全第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 三级管理与负责人责任
shots.scene: 老周给阿杰讲本实验室的空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains a blank lab safety handbook to the young male student.
shots.narration: 本实验室的手册和规程，要认真学。

shots.scene: 小研和老周填写空白的风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man fill in a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 新实验开始前，先做风险评估。

shots.scene: 危害、防护、应急三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a warning triangle, a shield and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 想清危害、防护措施和应急办法。

shots.scene: 高风险实验的空白申请单上盖章
shots.prompt_en: A blank approval form receives a stamp at the safety office. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险实验，按规定报批。

shots.scene: 实验室里喝水吃零食的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of eating snacks and drinking from a cup in the lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不吃东西、不喝水。

shots.scene: 化学品冰箱里放饮料的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of drinks and food in a lab refrigerator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不存放食品，不化妆。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起，穿长裤
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties back her long hair; she wears long trousers and closed shoes.
shots.narration: 长发扎起，穿长裤，不穿短裙。

shots.scene: 深夜一个人做危险实验的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lone person doing a hazardous experiment late at night under a moon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验，不要一个人做。

shots.section_title: 化学品分类储存与台账
shots.scene: 试剂柜里化学品按类别分区摆放
shots.prompt_en: A chemical storage cabinet with bottles grouped into separate labeled zones with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品按性质分类分区存放。
overlay: 化学品分类储存与台账

shots.section_title: 化学品分类储存与台账
shots.scene: 两类不能放一起的瓶子之间有隔板
shots.prompt_en: Two groups of bottles with different hazard pictograms separated by a divider, with a no-mixing icon. No people.
shots.narration: 相互反应的化学品，必须分开。

shots.section_title: 化学品分类储存与台账
shots.scene: 小研在空白台账上登记试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student records reagents in a blank chemical inventory logbook.
shots.narration: 建好台账，账物相符，少存少放。

shots.section_title: 化学品分类储存与台账
shots.scene: 带两把锁的保险柜图标
shots.prompt_en: A steel safe with two padlocks and two key icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 剧毒等管制化学品，专人专柜管理。

shots.section_title: 废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 往水槽倒废液的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of pouring liquid waste into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 废液绝不能倒进下水道。
overlay: 废物分类收集，不倒下水道

shots.section_title: 废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 几只贴着空白标签的废液桶分类摆放
shots.prompt_en: Several waste containers with blank labels sorted by type on a spill tray. No people.
shots.narration: 分类收集，盖紧，贴好标签。

shots.section_title: 废物分类收集，不倒下水道
shots.scene: 老李把废液桶送到学校统一收集点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer moves sealed waste containers on a cart to a central collection point.
shots.narration: 交学校统一收集处置。

shots.scene: 火焰图标和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 着火了，打119报警。

shots.scene: 红十字图标和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A red cross icon next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤，打120急救。

shots.scene: 报告链条：实验室负责人、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons: a lab room, a department building and a security office with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人、学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接电话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers the phone at the campus security desk.
shots.narration: 说清地点、情况和人员伤亡。

shots.scene: 阿杰关水龙头、关电源
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns off the tap and switches off the power of an instrument.
shots.narration: 离开前，关好水、电、气。

shots.scene: 小研检查气瓶阀门，然后锁门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes a gas cylinder valve, then turns off the lights and locks the lab door.
shots.narration: 检查一遍，关灯锁门再离开。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现SDS和安全手册图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank data sheet and a blank safety handbook.
shots.narration: 知道用什么，SDS和手册在哪。

shots.scene: 护目镜、实验服、手套图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, a lab coat and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 知道要什么防护，怎么用。

shots.scene: 检查过的仪器打勾，整洁的台面
shots.prompt_en: A checked instrument with a green check and a clean tidy bench. No people.
shots.narration: 设备先检查，台面保持整洁。

shots.scene: 出口标志、洗眼器标志和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an emergency exit sign, an eyewash sign and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，知道怎么应急。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰在实验室里点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student nod at each other in the tidy lab.
shots.narration: 听负责人的话，守规矩，天天安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前，身旁浮现准入证书和三级链条图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a blank whiteboard beside icons of an access certificate and a three-level chain.
shots.narration: 先培训准入，守好三级管理的规矩。

shots.scene: 风险评估表和防护用品图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank risk assessment form, goggles and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估，再按需选防护。

shots.scene: 通风柜、储存柜、气瓶链条图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood with a low sash, a flammable storage cabinet and a chained gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 用好通风柜，存好化学品和气瓶。

shots.scene: 标签全称、废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fully written blank label and a closed waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 标签写全称，废物分类交处置。

shots.scene: 119、120电话图标和报告链条
shots.prompt_en: Icons of two telephones and a three-step reporting chain. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，报警、急救、逐级报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the young male student and the female graduate student at the lab door.
shots.narration: 安全入门，从第一天开始。下次见！
